title: Amiss cross-repository relation evidence
description: One compact, plan-bound set of independently proven base and candidate projection values for two repository subjects. A null slot is explicitly unproven and carries no partial value. This document contains no relation verdict or claim that either subject is authoritative.

payload_digest.description: The domain-separated digest of the canonical payload bytes under the relation-evidence payload schema identity.

ProjectedValue.description: One complete canonical projection. value_digest is the plain SHA-256 of its exact canonical projected bytes; value_bytes is the length of those same bytes.

ProjectionSlot.description: A complete projected value, or null when this exact snapshot could not produce one. Null never proves an empty value, absence, or inequality.

plan_payload_digest.description: The exact relation-plan payload this producer evaluated.

subjects.description: Exactly two rows, byte-sorted and unique by role. Later assessment must bind these roles to the plan before comparing any value.
